rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for how likely a product or property is to sell.

example.english: This new phone has good marketability.
example.jyutping: ne1 fun2 san1 sau2 gei1 siu1 lou6 gei2 hou2

rows.note: Use this when focusing on the product's appeal to potential buyers rather than its actual sales prospects.

example.english: The attractive packaging gives the product high marketability.
example.traditional: 呢個包裝夠靚，產品嘅市場吸引力自然高。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 baau1 zong1 gau3 leng3 caan2 ban2 ge3 si5 coeng4 kap1 jan5 lik6 zi6 jin4 gou1
